desc: Ideation: median-based window cost + non-overlapping window selection DP; exactly k suffices since costs ≥ 0

Implement sliding-window cost computation with coordinate compression + two Fenwick trees (count, sum); median = kth element with kth=(x+1)//2; cost = med*lc - lsum + rsum - med*rc; build cost[i] for i in 0..n-x
Implement DP: dp[i][j] = min(dp[i-1][j], dp[i-x][j-1] + cost[i-x]) with (n+1)×(k+1) table (1.6e6 ints OK), init inf, dp[0][0]=0, return dp[n][k]

Test against both examples (expect 8 and 3) and brute-force cross-check on small random arrays — both examples pass; ~2000 random cases matched brute force; edge cases (all-equal, k*x==n, x==n, negatives, duplicates) verified
Confirm complexity O(n log n + n·k) time and O(n·k) space fits constraints (n ≤ 1e5, k ≤ 15)
